errors.evidence: The description claims the pink/red line for 'VideoLLaMB' is not clearly visible, but it is present in the plot. Although it is close to the 'VideoLLaMB-R' line, it is consistently visible just below it for most of the x-axis range. This statement is factually incorrect and leads to the omission of a full description for one of the five data series.
